price_why: A home baker would pay for the sampler-board and A/B/C-border carousel concepts. They have slide-by-slide direction and answer real tip-count and consistency questions. The long, cross-referenced research brief with unverified trend data and an empty section keeps it below $49.
one_line: A long, transparent research brief on vintage heart cake and Lambeth trends that ends in five ranked post concepts borrowed from embroidery and sewing-pattern formats.
strongest: The Lambeth sampler board and the one-heart-three-borders A/B/C carousel are concrete, cheap to make and tailored to home bakers. Each has a cover, slide list and hook, and each answers the tip-count question the trend research surfaced.
weakest: Much of the answer is trend reporting and source-status disclosure. One section is deliberately empty, and posts 2, 4 and 5 rely on cross-references or leave the cover or hook unresolved, so the creator still has to piece them together.
